METHOD: contract derived from wlnbb_engine source. "Unbounded" was NOT inferred from the historical 45-day divergence — that inference is explicitly rejected.
REJECTED_INFERENCE: historical incremental divergence => unbounded state. The divergence is evidence that SOME state was truncated, not evidence about which columns carry it.

BOUNDED_COLUMNS.basis: bucket from v.rolling(_BB_PERIOD=20, min_periods=1) mean/std(ddof=0); L3/L4/L6 from vol_up/down_adapted and prior-bar close/high/low comparisons
BOUNDED_COLUMNS.min_periods: 1 — partial windows produce values, so age<20 is INITIALIZATION_SENSITIVE, not UNAVAILABLE_HISTORY

carriers.l34_hi/l34_lo: anchored by first L34 bar in segment
carriers.setup_body_hi/lo: anchored by first setup_event = L34 | L22

UNBOUNDED_CARRIERS.UNDER_FIRE_RISK: the (l34_hi > 0) guard means an unanchored carrier yields 0 and the breakout is suppressed — identical in form to the g* latch under-fire risk

STATE_ANCHOR_RULE.principle: same reasoning that corrected g*: identify the observed event that forces every possible prior state to the same value
STATE_ANCHOR_RULE.anchors_are_themselves_bounded: L34, L22 and L43 are depth-20 features, so each anchor becomes computable once age >= 20

rule.be_up: requires BOTH the setup anchor and the L43 anchor, since BE_UP = BE_UP_BO | BE_UP_BX and an undetermined disjunct leaves the OR undetermined unless the other is True

L_SIG_CLASSIFICATION.structure: ascending-digit concat of L1..L6 (bounded), falling back to a named list that includes BO_UP/BE_UP/BX_UP (unbounded) and PRE_PUMP (cooldown, bounded n=6)
L_SIG_CLASSIFICATION.measured: on all sampled bounded bars an L-digit was active (100%), so the unbounded fallback path was never taken
L_SIG_CLASSIFICATION.caveat: 100% is MEASURED on 3 securities, not proven universally. If any bar has no active L-digit, l_sig on that bar inherits the unbounded anchor requirement.

reading.bo_up: cheap — L34 anchor present on 97-98% of bounded bars
reading.bx_up: EXPENSIVE — L43 anchor covers only 22-54% of bounded bars
reading.be_up: inherits the L43 cost through BE_UP_BX

not_done: C2 CISD state contract not yet derived
